items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: we also played behind, you know Nat Cole came in for three weeks, Mel Torme, and we backed them up and we got to know them pretty well

ctx.x: Well you got a little taste of it, you know, big band, you were what 20 years old?

Yeah. Twenty years old and we also played behind, you know Nat Cole came in for three weeks, Mel Torme, and we backed them up and we got to know them pretty well, and I mean just playing behind Nat for three weeks was worth the whole summer actually for me. And some acts that were not so enduring like Gogi Grant maybe and people of that — good but not the kind that are going to last forever.
So at least you decided well I am going to still pursue this. It didn’t knock you out of the thought of doing it.
